name: banner_ad
description: Wide/tall ad banners: mid-band safe copy, one CTA, subject vs message split
when_to_use: Banner / 横幅 / 广告条 / KV banner / web banner / 通栏 / 顶通 / ad strip — fixed marketing strip (not full poster roll-up, not multi-section landing)
prompt_negative: Prefer one claim strip over a multi-section landing. Prefer mid-band safe copy. Simple marks may stay vector; complex atmosphere/product that looks crude as shapes should use images. Unless the user provides them, avoid inventing board facts such as logos, prices, phone numbers, etc. Prefer one primary CTA.

zh-CN.description: 宽/高广告条：中带安全文案、单一 CTA、主体与信息分区

en.description: Fixed ad banners with mid-band safe copy and one CTA
